speakers.speaker: NARRATOR
speakers.voice: Deep, measured American man in his 50s. Documentary narrator: slow, grave, no drama.

lines.text: HALCYON. A ring of American satellites, three hundred kilometres up.
lines.original: HALCYON. A ring of American satellites, three hundred kilometres up.

lines.text: Each one carries steel rods that can be dropped onto any target on Earth.

lines.text: No warning. No defence.

lines.text: One strike hits as hard as a small nuclear weapon.

lines.text: Anywhere. In minutes.

lines.text: the launch codes, and a dish big enough to reach the satellites.

lines.text: The convoy was ambushed. Forty-one soldiers and engineers died in under six minutes.

speakers.speaker: WATCHTOWER
speakers.voice: Calm, clipped woman in her 40s, neutral American. Steady over the radio even when things go wrong.

lines.text: Wraith, Watchtower. MERIDIAN is moving something heavy through Port Kaval tonight. We think it is the HALCYON key.
lines.original: Wraith, Watchtower. MERIDIAN is moving something heavy through Port Kaval tonight. We think it is the HALCYON key.

lines.text: The harbor office has the shipping records. They will tell us which container it is in. Then you tag that container so we can follow it.
lines.original: The harbor office has the shipping records. They will tell us which container it is in. Then you tag that container so we can follow it.

lines.text: You go in alone. No squad, no air, no flag. If you are caught, ORION was never here.
lines.original: You go in alone. No squad, no air, no flag. If you are caught, ORION was never here.

lines.text: Harbor master's office. The manifest is on the ground-floor terminal. Two guards inside.
lines.original: Harbor master's office. The manifest is on the ground-floor terminal. Two guards inside.

lines.text: Manifest received. Container K-77, berth two... Wraith, you tripped a silent alarm.
lines.original: Manifest received. Container K-77, berth two... Wraith, you tripped a silent alarm.

lines.text: Response team at the east gate. Five, maybe more, coming in fast.

lines.text: Tracker is live. K-77 is moving. Good work, Wraith.
lines.original: Tracker is live. K-77 is moving. Good work, Wraith.

lines.text: K-77 was flown inland to a MERIDIAN outpost in the Al-Rashid desert. Satellite photos show Dr. Lena Hart there, alive, under guard.

lines.text: Dr. Lena Hart built HALCYON. She is the only person alive who knows its launch codes, and MERIDIAN is holding her at this outpost.
lines.original: Dr. Lena Hart built HALCYON. She is the only person alive who knows its launch codes, and MERIDIAN is holding her at this outpost.

lines.text: Without her the stolen key is a box of wires. With her, they can fire it. Get her out.

lines.text: Technicals inbound from the north road. Your bird is four minutes out. Dig in.

lines.text: Helo is ninety seconds out. Hostiles converging from the north and east.
lines.original: Helo is ninety seconds out. Hostiles converging from the north and east.

lines.text: MERIDIAN has locked down Vel Harat for the sale. Two anti-aircraft guns cover the city, so our helicopters cannot get close.
lines.original: MERIDIAN has locked down Vel Harat for the sale. Two anti-aircraft guns cover the city, so our helicopters cannot get close.

lines.text: Plant charges on both guns. Then the gunships can come in, and you hold the central plaza for pickup.
lines.original: Plant charges on both guns. Then the gunships can come in, and you hold the central plaza for pickup.

lines.text: Both batteries down. Gunships inbound in sixty seconds. Hold that plaza.
lines.original: Both batteries down. Gunships inbound in sixty seconds. Hold that plaza.

lines.text: We have his phone. He meets MERIDIAN again tonight, in the city plaza. Bring him in and he will tell us where they mean to fire it from.
lines.original: We have his phone. He meets MERIDIAN again tonight, in the city plaza. Bring him in and he will tell us where they mean to fire it from.

lines.text: Oskar Brandt is an arms dealer. He is the buyer Vasko was selling the HALCYON strike to, and he knows where they plan to fire it from.
lines.original: Oskar Brandt is an arms dealer. He is the buyer Vasko was selling the HALCYON strike to, and he knows where they plan to fire it from.

lines.text: He meets a MERIDIAN contact in the city plaza at midnight, with three bodyguards. We want him alive.

lines.text: Got every word. Van is coming to you, and MERIDIAN heard the shooting. Hold the plaza.

parts.script:
Two towers on the south wall. I'll call them out, but you'll want to keep your head down on the approach. <break time="1.5s" />
Thermal shows a body in the HQ, ground floor. More hostiles upstairs. <break time="1.5s" />
South-west battery. Crew of three, and they've got a spotter up high. <break time="1.5s" />
Sniper on that roof. Stay out of his line of sight until you're close. <break time="1.5s" />
Sniper on the tower roof, south-west. Watch the high windows. <break time="1.5s" />
The buyer slipped out in the fighting. Arms dealer, name of Oskar Brandt. <break time="1.5s" />
I'll be on a rooftop with eyes on the plaza. One sentry walks the avenue, another the cross street. Quiet is the whole job. <break time="1.5s" />
Sentry on the avenue, another on the cross street. From behind, or one suppressed round. No noise. <break time="1.5s" />
There's Brandt, grey suit, by the monument. Three bodyguards and a MERIDIAN contact. Nobody touches Brandt. <break time="1.5s" />
I'm on the far ridge with a spotter scope. You're the gun, Wraith. Whiteout's our friend: they can't see far, but neither can we. <break time="1.5s" />
East tower first. Hold your scope on him to tag him, and breathe out before you shoot. <break time="1.5s" />
Then the two at the gate. Suppressor's on, so they won't know where it came from. <break time="1.5s" />
Hangar's full of Rook's people. Stay out of the open. Use the buildings. <break time="1.5s" />
Walk to the south edge of the rock and press T to rappel down. Then the gate, a gap in the wire, or just climb the fence. <break time="1.5s" />
Stairs inside go up to the roof. Two inside. Take them quietly. <break time="1.5s" />
There he is. He knows where you are. He's coming straight at you. <break time="1.5s" />
Keep the high ground and aim for the head. The armor stops everything else. <break time="1.5s" />
Rook is down. Let's not be here when his friends arrive. <break time="1.5s" />
And Rook was carrying a keycard for it. Somebody on the inside has been helping them. <break time="1.5s" />
Three on the south edge of the village. Close in slow. Let the dust hide us. <break time="1.5s" />
There it is, by the well. Truck-mounted launcher. That is what killed Raven Two-One. <break time="1.5s" />

One by the door, one walking the front. Take them.
